Planets mode is the Eye's §9mode switch§r: the Galaxy panel, or OpenComputers setMode("planets"). The galaxy chart in the slot picks the tier: Triangulum gives§9 3 slots§r, the Milky Way 6. The planets field lights at once, with no collapse.
- Planet items (the dimension display blocks) go in the §9slot bus§r, the plinth's p input bus. They are read, never consumed. Taking a planet out of the slot bus abandons only that planet's run.
- One gauge (P, drift 1 × (β - 1), calm), no events, a quarter of the demand.
- Each planet runs at parallel 2^(N - k). Its success per parallel is (1 - 0.05 × rocket tier) × the field factor (Resonant and Stable 1, Strained 0.5, Critical 0).
- Each slot pays its run at the start (Hydrogen and Helium × parallel from the buffers, and its EU) and waits while it cannot (Slots [1]). A Breach fails the runs in flight and re-forms the field.

[warn]Switching the mode puts a lit galaxy out; it comes back only through the Magnetar Collapse.[/warn]

§2§lDONE §lWHEN§r you have run planets mode (tick the box).
